Interface GameLogger

All Known Implementing Classes:
CommandLogger, NoOpCommandLogger
public interface GameLogger
Strategy interface for persisting the sequence of game commands to a durable log. Enables crash recovery via NDJSON replay.

Two implementations exist:

  • CommandLogger — writes to a file under logs/
  • NoOpCommandLogger — discards all writes (Null Object Pattern)

  • Method Details

    • logGameInit

      void logGameInit(String gameId, long seed, List<String> nicknames, Map<String,Totem> chosenTotems)
      Writes the GAME_INIT record. Must be called once before any logCommand(GameCommand, String) calls.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the game's unique identifier
      seed - the random seed used to initialize the game
      nicknames - ordered list of player nicknames
      chosenTotems - mapping from nickname to chosen totem

    • logCommand

      void logCommand(GameCommand cmd, String senderNickname)
      Writes a COMMAND record after the command has been successfully applied to the model.
      Parameters:
      cmd - the command that was executed
      senderNickname - the player who issued the command

    • logGameEnded

      void logGameEnded()
      Writes the GAME_ENDED record. After this entry the log will not be replayed on server restart.

    • close

      void close()
      Flushes and closes the underlying writer, releasing any file handles. Must be called when the game session ends.
